rules.summary: Tutoring staff salaries can be charged only in proportion to the time each person worked on the Program.
rules.quote: Grant funds may be used for tutoring program staff salaries in proportion to time worked on the Program.

rules.summary: Tutoring books and supplies are allowable.
rules.quote: Grant funds may be used for tutoring books and supplies.

rules.summary: Snacks for students in the program are allowable.
rules.quote: Grant funds may be used for snacks for participating students.

rules.summary: Consultants or contractors cannot be charged without the Foundation's prior written approval.
rules.quote: Grant funds may not be used for consultants or contractors without the Foundation's prior written approval.

rules.summary: Fundraising events, alcohol, and staff entertainment cannot be charged to the grant.
rules.quote: Grant funds may not be used for fundraising events, alcohol, or staff entertainment.

rules.summary: General operating costs like rent, utilities, and office supplies cannot be charged to the grant.
rules.quote: Grant funds may not be used for general operating costs such as rent, utilities, or office supplies.

rules.summary: Time records must be kept for every staff member whose salary is charged to the grant.
rules.quote: The Grantee shall maintain time records for staff whose salaries are charged to this grant.

rules.summary: A quarterly financial report showing the expenses charged to the grant must be submitted.
rules.quote: The Grantee shall submit a financial report each quarter showing expenses charged to this grant.
